summary: Pipeline/Customer swap fix VERIFIED end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 new swap-fix tests + 26/26 regression tests = 41/41 PASS (one transient network timeout on the preview URL, re-ran individually and passed — logged as flaky, not a real failure). /api/pipeline (manager) returns 45 real prospects (Lead 23, Demo 21, Contacted 1) including SANMISH, Sigma Sealing, MBM INDIA, Rittal; NO 'Dropped' rows leak; NO acquired customers leak. /api/customers (manager) returns exactly 4 acquired: Rishab Global, GRANDLY WIRES, Etibahn, A2K INFRA — all with revenue>0, no pipeline prospects leak, zero company overlap with /api/pipeline. Monthly target regression still holds: manager=₹2Cr; Σ(8 reps)=₹2Cr exactly. Rep RBAC intact (pawan.giri sees only own rows). PATCH stage=Won still creates customer. /api/sync + /api/sync/status include pipeline_deals(45)/customers(4)/targets(9) counts. Frontend visually confirmed via mobile viewport: Pipeline tab shows LEAD/CONTACTED/DEMO cards with correct prospects; Customers tab shows only 4 acquired names — swap FIXED.

rca_of_issue: Resolved. Root cause was that the two Google Sheet tabs were misidentified: gid=2046569261 (labelled 'Pipeline') was really a monthly forecast/achievement dashboard, while gid=891446056 (labelled 'Acquired Customers') was the real pipeline with a Stage column. The fix (a) added SHEET_URL_ACHIEVEMENT env var pointing to gid=2046569261, (b) repointed SHEET_URL_PIPELINE to gid=891446056, (c) rewrote parse_pipeline to read the Stage column and map to the app taxonomy (skipping 'Dropped'), (d) split rows by stage — stage=='Won' becomes customers, stage!='Won' becomes open pipeline, and (e) derived monthly per-rep targets from parse_achievement. Verified: no company appears in both /api/pipeline and /api/customers; stages restricted to Lead/Contacted/Demo/Negotiation; monthly target invariant unchanged.
